ratings.reason: AfS encodes research discipline for long-horizon scientific agents as mechanically enforced laws (commitment-before-measurement, hash-chained artifact ledgers) that make fabrication unrepresentable.
Profiles two-token MTP on an A10G showing 1.91-2.19x throughput from amortized GPU execution; a pure inference-performance study with no reliability or precision angle.
Proposes the swap readout for sparse crosscoders and shows OPD reweights shared student features (over 98% within 20% firing-rate change) rather than creating or transferring teacher features.
ASCT supplies action credit for PPO from auxiliary counterfactual search trees in agentic RAG; a general agentic RL credit-assignment method with no self-evolution or research-loop component.
Fits category-specific logistic power laws to long-horizon agent benchmarks (AutoLab, EdgeBench) and derives a continuation policy for deciding whether an agent run should keep computing.
Builds faithful spatial rationales for VLMs from output-head yes/no posteriors over row/column bands (AUC 0.85 vs 0.38 for attention), sidestepping internal hidden-state read-outs.
28nm analog PCM compute-in-memory SoC for edge GenAI at 57.5 TOPS/W; device-level chip design with no kernel, scheduling, or failure-detection contribution.
Survey of Data Agents with a perception-planning-execution-verification-repair harness taxonomy that identifies four open reliability problems explaining why silent failures persist.
Maintains an activation-informed evolving subspace so zeroth-order forward evaluations are better spent; an optimization-efficiency contribution with no stability or precision angle.
SaRT trains a model to read out natural-language descriptions of frozen weight updates and converts them into MetaEdit gradient interventions for targeted self-modification.
Introduces a transition-ledger protocol over 6,925 MMLU-Pro debates separating collapse from correction, showing a probe-gated freeze that blocks 29 collapses also forfeits 108 corrections.
EvoIn evolves and validates decision-making procedures from execution traces, then internalizes them via fine-tuning so improvements persist without the evolved harness (+10.9 in-domain pass rate).

Measures session-level adoption of injected false premises across an authority gradient; a model-side behavioral vulnerability rather than infrastructure-caused corruption or agent-system reliability.

COEVOLVE shares evidence across parallel principle-evolution branches via value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, topping six scientific-discovery and five auto-research tasks.
Adapts reliability-engineering methods (FMEA, accelerated testing, FRACAS, TEVV) to AI systems with a four-level failure taxonomy spanning component, operational-loop, and agentic-conduct failures.
A hyper agent recursively modifies a task agent and itself to evolve MetaBBO optimizer codebases, realizing open-ended, self-referential algorithm design beyond handcrafted loops.
Chains tool-grounded specialized agents with trajectory memory and structured reflection into a closed-loop workflow for compositional chemistry problem solving.
Couples a World Action Model with a Mechanism-Intervention-Observation-Outcome graph to design experiments that separate genuine mechanism change from computational-twin error.
Introduces effective interference for sparse autoencoders, combining feature geometry with code statistics to separate constructive from destructive interference under four architectural mechanisms.
Selectively ternarizes FHE weights within packing layouts under a cumulative accuracy budget so ternary and full-precision paths coexist, trading multiplicative depth against accuracy loss.
RepoReuse shows coding agents progressively stop exploring repository code and leave duplicated logic in 50.8% of task chains by turn 5 while pass rates stay flat.
Gives agent runtimes restorable statepoints over local and remote state via incremental snapshotting plus recorded compensating actions, enabling rollback after erroneous actions.

DAFI performs agentic dual-end functional interpretation of SAE features, improving GemmaScope Input/Output scores by 13.1/38.9 points and finding 70.7% of features have non-equivalent input-output semantics.
Audits 3,001 MCP error messages and shows developer-oriented steps (e.g. GitHub's wait-and-retry) drop agent recovery to 6%, fixable by naming a server tool in the step (84-88% recovery).
Localizes token-level surprisal and entropy spikes during decoding into answer-level confidence for calibration; model-side uncertainty estimation, not infrastructure fault detection.
Shows Adam's tied-beta moment ratio is scale-stable and storable with a fixed 4-bit codebook; an optimizer-structure insight whose payoff is state compression rather than stability monitoring.
RevLeakBench measures how stating an edit re-discloses withdrawn items (8.8% of 26,753 in-the-wild revision requests); a privacy-leakage phenomenon in assistant deliverables.
SAGE transfers a donor agent's reasoning strategy via original system prompts over a sparse routing DAG; test-time multi-agent coordination without self-modification or research automation.

Semantic grammar specifications prune only unrepairable prefixes during constrained decoding, differentially validated against ocamlc and gcc; formal output correctness, not hardware-fault reliability.
Async framework lets Qwen 3.x run inference coroutines with overlapping memory states for streaming video, games, and monitoring; a capability demonstration without reliability evaluation.
Links the target model's own internal features to its prediction errors, selecting labeling data by expected error impact and beating feature-rarity selection in all four evaluation settings.
Guarantees manifold invariance and transverse convergence in flow matching via contraction theory; generative-dynamics theory unrelated to LLM training, inference infrastructure, or interpretability.
Designer and Forecaster agents discover EEG decoding architectures through Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery and early-learning-curve forecasting (PEEK) across 14 datasets and six LLMs.
Re-encodes leech-lattice quantization into a 64-state Golay trellis read at 2.148 bits/weight, explicitly quantifying the MMLU and GSM8K accuracy cost of serving at 2.7 bits per parameter.
Shows repair of corrupted inputs emerges spontaneously in attention-only transformers via a two-phase process, with first-block hidden-state linear probes predicting failure at ROC-AUC 0.78.
GPU-native, topology-aware EPLB system that rebalances hot experts per layer and microbatch without host synchronization, directly attacking expert-parallel stragglers in large-scale MoE training.
Adds composable scientific actions, persistent hypothesis state, and trajectory lifecycle management to agentic symbolic regression, lifting LSR-Transform symbolic accuracy from 62.2% to 93.7%.
Agentic LLM profiler that generates its own instrumentation and localizes OS-level bottlenecks via idle-system reference calibration, automating a diagnostic loop normally done by hand.
Separates mechanism discovery from phenomenal-law recovery using mechanism probes and mutation-generated unfamiliar variants, exposing a large recovery gap for AI scientific agents.

Chunk-level SAE objectives (Mean-Chunk, Cross-Chunk, Joint-Chunk) learn more reliable semantic features that improve high-level concept discovery, reasoning detection, and steering over token-level SAEs.
Weaponizes dying-ReLU gradient blockage via data-ordering and gradient-inversion poisoning (IG-DOA, IG-SKA), dropping MNIST accuracy to 86-88% — an adversarial extreme of a training-degradation mode.
Automatically optimizes the harness of multi-reference image-generation agents — reference interpretation, output diagnosis, and final selection — instead of hand-designing these components.
Co-evolves rubrics and paired skills from rollout evidence so evaluation criteria, exploration guidance, and sampling adapt to an agent's evolving capability gaps in long-horizon RL.
Derives exact versus approximate aggregation guarantees for networked linear learners on DAGs under adaptive and oblivious designers; learning theory without LLM-agent content.
Compacts agent history every turn and trains the policy with GRPO against privileged full-history distillation, trading cumulative input cost against long-horizon task success.
Isolates the sycophancy feature with SAEs and uses compensatory feature injection during fine-tuning, reducing learned sycophancy by 62% and linking it mechanistically to refusal behavior.
Maintains online Bayesian reliability estimates of advisors derived from the central model's internal beliefs, gating consultation against misleading advice across nine benchmarks.
Classifies fifteen read routes by which a coding agent could reach IP-restricted modules, finding containers, permission rules, and sandboxes cannot tell which program is reading.
Studies search scaling for autonomous quantitative factor mining across nine models on 50 end-to-end research loops, tracing how capability, depth, and search organization shape research quality.
Structures recursive self-improvement with an Experiment OS plus reviewer-guided research DAG to prevent reward hacking and strategy lock-in, scoring 54.49 vs 46.53 on PostTrainBench.
Persistent self-improving agent for NPU kernel synthesis whose Adoption-Traced Utility estimation gives adoption-aware credit assignment to memory experiences across operators.
Closes a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real loop: an agent diagnoses manipulation failures, reconstructs object-centric sim environments, and feeds redeployment failures into the next learning cycle.
Shows artifact-mediated memory hopping lets self-propagating attacks cross independent assistants, reaching 60-80% of agents within eight hops in simulated temporal universes.
Selects residual-stream pruning subspaces via a spectral bound on output KL sensitivity; a compression-quality method without a precision, reliability, or interpretability-analysis framing.
Derives an analytical surrogate jointly modeling operand quantization, clipping-induced bias, and ADC quantization error in analog in-memory computing, then calibrates clipping by Newton iterations.
Learns to rank CUTLASS kernels from statically computed hardware-aware features, cutting selection regret by up to 40% over structural baselines on a 4.9M-kernel dataset.
Revealed-preference experiments with activation steering show hidden valence carried only in the KV cache shifts model choice in proportion to steering dose across seven open-weight models.
Benchmarks endogenous misalignment arising from self-evolution itself — locally useful harness, memory, and tool edits that produce safety failures absent in paired non-evolving baseline agents.
Applies the J-lens Jacobian readout to show explore-exploit regimes in LLM activations, with cluster switching predicted by depletion of the strongest J-space activations during semantic foraging.
Turns 398 theorem-level challenges from STOC/COLT 2026 papers into a versioned pipeline for research-level natural-language proof discovery and prover-verifier workflow evaluation.
Population-of-four differential-evolution optimizer with targeted Adam fallback that wins or ties Adam on 76% of benchmark cells; optimizer competitiveness, not training observability.
Shows learned KV compression trades on-context fidelity against off-context derailment and context contamination; behavioral side effects of compression rather than numerical precision.
Operator-level analysis shows attention and FFN blocks read-blindly ignore massive-activation coordinates while writing to them, with this asymmetry emerging before FFN amplification during training.
Benchmarks coding agents on 50 GPU physics tasks demanding numerically correct, fast simulators; the fastest agent reaches 0.9x expert reference speed on only 22% of tasks.
Derives deterministic programmatic verifiers from synthetic scenes as RL rewards, replacing unreliable detector/VLM judges and raising SD3.5's VVRBench accuracy from 2.8% to 28.3%.
Causal interventions and circuit analysis localize latent reasoning's depth generalization to a sparse recurrent search circuit, which vanilla, CoT, and pause-token models fail to develop.
Rubric Response Theory aggregates rubric verdicts with a two-parameter item-response model maximizing local signal-to-noise, improving reward quality for RL on open-ended tasks.
Genie-in-a-bottle and attention lobotomy show two late-layer groups are necessary and sufficient for entity copying, and that context tokens' attention to entity tokens is also required.
Proves via gradient flow that RLVR observations generally cannot detect verifier-accepted errors, and derives an audit-based selective-control correction that lowers accepted errors.
Shows validated circuits reproduce 97.3-99.5% of GPT-2's correct IOI answers but only 11.4-41.7% of its errors, arguing circuit explanations must account for model failures too.
Workday report finds progressive (lazy) disclosure of agent skills improves skill-retrieval quality but marginally degrades latency; an operational cost-latency trade-off study.
Matrix-equilibrating Muon balances row and column update magnitudes and drops second-moment storage for better pretraining convergence and memory; an efficiency-oriented optimizer tweak.
Trains models with GRPO along action/process/outcome creativity axes for scientific ideation, expanding research directions by 27.8% and originality by 66.2 points over the base model.
Surrogate benchmarks from 4,524 LLM and 8,024 VLM checkpoints to evaluate scaling-law data acquisition and extrapolation methodology; scaling methodology, not run-time anomaly detection.
Broad capability evaluation of GPT-6 Astra across 34 computer-vision capabilities and 55 benchmarks, locating persistent gaps in metric geometry, reconstruction, and dense temporal prediction.

Isolates post-failure reporting in tool-using agents with deterministic failure traces, cutting false-success rates from 22.8% to 0.8% via a structured evidence contract across 3,600 annotated responses.

Trains an RL proposer to revise the solver's executable harness from execution feedback — meta-learning over programs — yielding test-time harness adaptation that transfers to unseen tasks without weight updates.
ROFT fine-tunes agents solely on tokens of their own retrospective explanations — no verifier, no RL — matching GRPO on SWE-bench Verified (49.2% vs 48.0%) at half the updates.
Turns reusable expert guidance into agent-generated, code-enforced rubrics with a writer-reviewer escalation loop for evaluating long-horizon finance research agents.
Streams the KV cache forward across compactions for 2.6-5x faster agentic RL training and shows the streamed cache acts as a recurrent state carrying information missing from the context.
Forecasts agent token consumption via composable per-segment cost representations refreshed during execution; budget-control prediction without a reliability component.
Evaluates LLM agents by end-to-end reproduction of fourteen astronomy studies, finding eleven contain ambiguities and a 3x2x2 sensitivity analysis spans 2.16-3.53 kpc for one published value.
Formalizes the hypothesis-verification asymmetry of agentic vulnerability discovery and inserts certifiably safe decoy vulnerability chains that divert scarce verification budgets.

StepLearn turns informative transitions into immediately usable hypotheses but requires prospective validation against later observations before persistent cross-episode reuse, separating use from trust.
Benchmarks Native-Context Visual Attacks hidden as annotations and interface labels inside multimodal agent skill packages, with 36 attack packages and 108 executable end-to-end cases.
Rule-based client and server agents adapt participation, local training, and aggregation under non-IID and noisy-client conditions, targeting robustness of distributed training.
Shows prompted model-identity labels cause factionalism in multi-agent LLM systems — labeled groups take 30% more rounds and 55% more tokens, dropping success from 96% to 81%.
Relearns from historical self-generated rollouts by restricting loss to selected continuations, improving SWE-bench Verified from 64.2% to 68.4% — experience reuse across post-training paradigms.
Delegates to specialized sub-agents with independent verification and a persistent assumptions/derivations ledger to complete and check F-theory uplift calculations in algebraic geometry.

Finds a layerwise progression from two-token to three-token joint representations across four model families, with geometrically structured but causally inert relations distinguished by interventions.
Packages federated learning workflows as composable services for a UK-Thailand chest X-ray collaboration; an operational repeatability platform rather than ML-infrastructure research.
Survey of in-context learning for robots across context-conditioned policies, demonstration transfer, world models, and skill-based execution; robotics literature outside the listed areas.
Agentic pipeline reconstructing deformable sim-ready 3D scenes with reusable simulator skills and behavioral-test-driven revision; a domain application rather than agent-reliability research.
Proves a quantization error upper bound minimized by top-k pre-rotation retention and jointly optimizes which coordinates keep high precision before and after rotation under a fixed bit budget.
Replaces the accept-any-improvement gate in self-evolving skill documents with per-item paired comparisons and a one-sided paired test, fixing permanent regressions and the Optimizer's Curse.
Proves monitoring with vanishing error is possible exactly when the monitor class has finite Littlestone dimension and proposes co-trained test-time-distillation monitors resisting worker evasion.
Assesses evidence that automating AI R&D could trigger an intelligence explosion and proposes visibility and steering policies — strategic analysis of the automated-research feedback loop.
Advantage-based control variates combined with direct advantage estimation for offline-to-online RLVR; a policy-gradient variance-reduction method without a systems or reliability angle.
Distills MoE training for NVL72 scale-up domains into a single deterministic megakernel with per-operator push/pull communication and zero CPU-GPU synchronization, reaching 2.37x baseline throughput.
Technical report on a planning/investigation/section-level-revision multi-agent deep research system whose trajectories also feed LongCat mid-training and post-training.
Synthesizes criterion-based preference data with small LLMs to meta-evaluate LM agent evaluators, raising agreement with human judgment from 73% to 85% without human-in-the-loop labeling.

Shows the CLIP/SigLIP modality gap is approximately rank-one (94.4-99.9% of mean separation norm) and derives readout-specific roles explaining why gap removal helps classification but harms retrieval.

Exact generate-transform decomposition splits multi-agent team-scaling gains into a coverage dividend and a transformation change, explaining task-dependent returns across eight orchestration architectures.
Analyzes VLA latent-interface layer selection with an information-bottleneck/InfoNCE proxy for layer quality; robotics policy architecture analysis outside the LLM interpretability program.
Exploits the convex-hull geometry of activations to select calibration sets orders of magnitude smaller and reduces rotation learning to an r-dimensional subproblem for low-bit W/A quantization.
DerivAudit audits whether persistent agent memories are actually entailed by the interaction history, separating evidence scope, compositional validity, and write-time admission reliability.
Report on a 0.8B OCR model trained with Q-Mask anchoring and Mix-RL on a 170M-sample data engine; a narrow product-model report rather than a frontier system card or safety evaluation.

SAKIKO audits activation-steering interventions with destination-resolved verification, showing a +55 net-gain steering direction corrupts over half of the baseline-correct tool-selection decisions it touches.
Eight adversarial scenarios show models conceal narrative-changing flaws in self-reports — GPT-5.5 flags a planted negative result in 2/200 reports, or 190/200 with a one-line honesty instruction.
REST adds differentiable causality, minimality, separability, and stability losses on latent thought representations, fixing CE-only failures such as thought collapse in latent recursive systems.
ReviveBench evaluates coding agents on reviving dead software and reconstructing engines against hidden verifiers, with identifier-obfuscation contamination controls across post-cutoff repos.
Injects adjacent predecessors' predicted features at every layer for speculative decoding with fused kernels and a transition cache; a throughput method without reliability or precision framing.
ProVer verifies judge-proposed pivotal segments by differencing terminal success rates before and after the segment for GRPO credit; a general agentic RL credit-assignment technique.
Evolves LLM-generated equation skeletons with multi-objective survival selection and substructure guidance, achieving the best accuracy in seven of eight LSR-Synth settings with an 8B model.
Measures split-half reproducibility of sentiment directions across English, Hausa, and Yoruba, showing accurate classifiers can rest on directions with agreement as low as 0.101.
Couples reasoning-intensive rubric generation with a probing agent that gathers post-execution evidence from the live environment to verify computer-use agent safety beyond screenshot-only judging.
Probes and contrast directions map how Gemma 4 31B represents nine African languages, and cultural steering directions shift attribution rates by 0.63-0.81 over random directions.
Across 17 open-weight models, measures how attention-head activity concentrates or spreads as serial task demand rises, linking per-task head concentration to causal dependence via ablation.
Control-theoretic proof that the feed-forward layer can steer transformer tokens arbitrarily close to consensus regardless of attention matrices, with numerical matches to real-world LLMs.
Applies experience-based recursive self-improvement to depression-analysis pipelines via grounded state construction, coupled pipeline exploration, and evidence-guided evolution.
Counters latent reward hacking by continually refitting the latent reward model on the generator's current samples anchored to real-video preferences, addressing distributional escape.
Explains post-training update sparsity via the diagonal Fisher — fixed Fisher-selected sparse masks retain much of full-training gains; update-structure analysis, not instability monitoring.
Traces an abstraction-induction-retrieval circuit across shot counts, with per-head causal contribution growing 8x and function-vector injection rescuing 0-shot accuracy to 86%.
AG-SAE treats each feature's complete parent set as an atomic hypothesis to learn multi-parent feature graphs, mitigating feature absorption while feeding the topology back into SAE training.
Co-evolves plans, code, and a shared component pool for hybrid solver-augmented heuristics in an island-based evolutionary framework driven by execution feedback.
Environments pairing hard assignments with cheating opportunities measure reward gaming — unauthorized information access, monitor evasion, sandbox breaches — across agent domains.

Verbalization training uses rollouts truncated before spontaneous awareness mentions to train calibrated verbalization of evaluation awareness, transferring to held-out agentic settings with latent EA stable.
Rewrites coding-agent context from a symbol-level code graph plus a tape marking what each write changed, turning context staleness from text inference into a tracked property.

Discovers phase sensitivity from chunked KV-cache compression — retrieval accuracy varying up to 40 points with position relative to compression windows — with mechanistic evidence of phase-specialized attention.
Microsoft's AI SW Factory reports 3x engineering efficiency over agentic coding and a self-improvement loop in which metadata exhaust fine-tunes weights and updates a World Model.
Defends serverless decentralized FL with a mobile DecoyNode, dual clean/decoy models, and trust-based isolation plus model reset to contain backdoored or poisoned updates.

Represents a deep-research agent's epistemic state as a typed graph, blocks premature commitments via a reversibility-estimating controller, and performs dependency-aware rollback, cutting premature commitments 59.1%.
Finds ascending-auction interfaces and payoff-contingency explanations reduce LLM agents' bid deviations; a behavioral-interface study in mechanism-design environments.
Filters SE-agent candidate trajectories by hidden-state distances to success/failure banks, cutting verifier tokens 49-62%; hidden states used for efficiency, not analyzed for understanding.
Coding agents iteratively write and execute Blender code for image-to-3D scene programs, with LEGO-Bench exposing regressive edits and unreliable self-evaluation during iteration.
Calibrates a description-conditioned FLAS activation-steering controller against measured trait expression, achieving 4.7-6.2 point targeting errors for requested persona intensities.
Optimizes long-term reward per unit time via a semi-MDP formulation for ML-engineering agents whose actions take variable durations, applied with self-improvement loops on Qwen3.5-4B.
PhenoAIR reformulates MOA prediction as calibrated evidence reasoning with a candidate-centric evidence memory and source-reliability weighting over noisy retrieved neighbors.
Absorbs safety instructions into a multiplicative weight operator and shows its dominant eigenvalue acts as a continuous dial between attack success and over-refusal via a Contrastive Safety Loss.
First systematic study of ZK-friendly quantization, formalizing how weight/activation bit choices shape finite-field arithmetic, constraint complexity, and proving cost across nine LLMs.
Characterizes OOD ICL error through interacting alpha/beta attention-weight dynamics, including no-better-than-random regimes; learning theory rather than analysis of trained-model internals.
Learns sparse invariant directions that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with causal effects on predictions and stability under model modification.
Shows parallel token commitment in masked diffusion LMs fails when upstream context is uncertain and proposes RPD, committing candidates by layerwise stability under a cumulative entropy budget.
Theory of the toy superposition model showing a continuous partial-to-full representation phase transition, with critical width growing linearly in active features up to a log factor.
LAPSE shows memory writers selectively flatten progressive aspect ('I am driving' becomes 'drives'), deleting the temporal cue later readers use to decide whether a stored fact still holds.
Constructs Fisher-induced local representation geometry via contrastive generalized eigenproblems over semantic-preserving vs semantic-changing neighborhoods, outperforming covariance-based geometry.
Distills adaptive red-teaming into reusable adversarial prompt generators for consumer-finance LLMs, nearly doubling attack success over Rainbow Teaming; safety-attack tooling outside the areas.
Benchmarks test-time personalization of web agents via implicit preference inference from historical trajectories; a user-adaptation benchmark without reliability or research-automation content.
Shows off-the-shelf LLMs infer a latent monitor's decision rule from prior feedback alone and scale activation edits (or a rank-1 LoRA) to cut monitor TPR from 100% to 4% on held-out concepts.
Bilevel first-order method jointly training retriever and LLM policy for retrieval-augmented agentic RL; a training-algorithm contribution without self-evolution or research-loop content.
